name: in_process
one_line: The step runs inside the calling process.
how_it_works: Call the step body as a function.
pros: Nothing to pay. The fastest possible placement.
Simplest to debug: one stack, one process, one log.
No serialisation, so a step can be handed any Python object.
cons: No containment at all. A step that exits, exhausts memory or writes a file takes the host with it.
A step can reach anything the host process can reach, including credentials in the environment.
Hidden shared state makes a broken transport look like it works.
pick_this_when: The step body is your own trusted code.
You are measuring something else and want no noise.
avoid_when: The step body is generated, or comes from a model, or touches anything you would not run as yourself.
